title.zh: 将索索贡省普列托迪亚斯市镇布拉万村奈皮特社区学校的名称变更为布拉万社区学校的法案
title.en: An Act to Change the Name of the Naipit Community School in the Barrio of Bulauan, Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, to Bulauan Community School
title.orig: An Act to Change the Name of the Naipit Community School in the Barrio of Bulauan, Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, to Bulauan Community School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Naipit Community tại Barrio Bulauan, Đô thị Prieto Diaz, Tỉnh Sorsogon thành Trường Bulauan Community
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียน Naipit Community ในบารังไกย์ Bulauan เทศบาล Prieto Diaz จังหวัด Sorsogon เป็นโรงเรียน Bulauan Community
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Naipit Community di Barrio Bulauan, Kotamadya Prieto Diaz, Provinsi Sorsogon menjadi Sekolah Bulauan Community
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Naipit Community di Barrio Bulauan, Perbandaran Prieto Diaz, Wilayah Sorsogon kepada Sekolah Bulauan Community

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1036_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Naipit Community School in the Barrio of Bulauan, Municipality of Prieto Diaz, Province of Sorsogon, is hereby changed to Bulauan Community School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
